subject: Project Atlas: trial environment install snag & next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@ellis-tech.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@ellis-tech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project Atlas: trial environment install snag & next steps

Hi Jordan / Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the install run you attempted:

Summary of what we covered
- Goal: validate Atlas search reranking in production-like traffic for 2 weeks (targeting 50k queries/day).
- Current blocker: outbound calls from Ellis staging to our hosted inference endpoint are blocked by a firewall egress policy. Install completed but model pull failed (see attached install-log.txt).

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) If Ellis prefers hosted eval: we can issue a short-lived staging token and IP allowlist to avoid model pulls from outside. I can send the token today if you confirm.
2) If you need on-prem: our engineer can provide an offline model bundle + installer; requires a small network config change on your side.
3) Schedule a 30-min remediation call with infra + security to validate the egress rule and confirm timeline.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether procurement needs a separate proposal? If you want hosted for the first 30 days, I can loop Ben and Laura to fast-track approvals and a one-off credit.

Attachments: trial-checklist.pdf, install-log.txt

Thanks — I know timing is tight for your October evaluation window.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

---
Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference.

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@ellis-tech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@ellis-tech.com, Samira Khan <samira.khan@ellis-tech.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Atlas: trial environment install snag & next steps

Vivek —

Thanks for the summary and for the quick turnaround on the checklist. Appreciate the options.

Short update from our side: the staging team confirmed the installer ran but the model pull failed when attempting to reach your hosting endpoint (they saw 403 on the fetch). Our security team is conservative about outbound calls to third-party inference endpoints; they will need an approved vendor list and procurement sign-off. I've CC'd procurement above.

If you can provide a hosted-token + IPs to allowlist that might be the fastest path for us to get rolling while procurement does paperwork. Also, can you share a short description of the data flow and whether any customer data is persisted on your side for the eval?

I'll coordinate infra + procurement but won't be able to unblock until next Tuesday at the earliest.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Search Engineering
Ellis Technologies

Hi Jordan / Samira —

Following up on this thread since I haven't heard back after your note. To reduce lift for infra, we can do one of the following immediately:

- Option A (fastest): issue a hosted temporary token + IP allowlist (valid 30 days). No model or customer data is persisted beyond token-scoped logs; I can send the token and list of IPs now.
- Option B: provide an offline model bundle and an ops-runbook so your infra can pull locally (works for air-gapped environments).
- Option C: schedule a 20-minute troubleshooting call (we can have an engineer on the line to walk the install).

If procurement requires a statement of no-persistence and a short SOC2 excerpt, Laura can attach the doc. Ben can also propose a small credit for the evaluation window if you want hosted.

I want to respect your timelines — if this is no longer a priority for October, please let me know and we can pause the trial and revisit in November. Otherwise, if you confirm "hosted" I will send the token and IPs today and book a call with one of our engineers.

Attachments: hosted-temp-token.txt (placeholder)

Best,
Vivek
